answer: Hold every agent's earnings in a time-locked escrow that vests slowly, the way a vine climbs a trellis one season at a time. Make that trellis ferrous, forged from accrued honest work rather than bought, so it cannot be faked overnight. If an identity is later proven sybil, the chain retroactively claws back and burns its entire vested balance. A clone farm then forfeits every past reward at once, and the more it earned, the more it loses, leaving the whole operation net-negative.
